description: This file declares functions related to rbus interval subscriptions, including adding and removing subscription records. It's part of a larger rbus library related to subscriptions and event handling.

methods.name: rbusInterval_AddSubscriptionRecord
methods.description: Adds a subscription record for a property identified by the given node and subscription details.

methods.name: rbusInterval_RemoveSubscriptionRecord
methods.description: Removes a subscription record for a property identified by the given node and subscription details.
